ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL Destructive Query
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the invocation of MS SQL transactions that are destructive towards table or database data, such as "DROP TABLE" or "DROP DATABASE".
 Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "MSSQLSERVER\$AUDIT" AND event_id = 33205 AND (Data = RGX(".*statement\\:TRUNCATE\\ TABLE.*") OR Data = RGX(".*statement\\:DROP\\ TABLE.*") OR Data = RGX(".*statement\\:DROP\\ DATABASE.*")))
